_meta.source: Goldman Sachs, Meta Platforms Inc. (META) Q2'26 Review (Sheridan et al.), 30 Jul 2026, Exhibit 4
_meta.method: Equal blend of (1) EV/GAAP-EBIT x NTM+1 EBIT and (2) EV/FCF-SBC x NTM+4 estimates discounted back 3 years at 12% CAPM
_meta.note: META is valued at GROUP level (no SOTP exhibit in the note). Method 1 maps to the analyst-style engine as a single segment with 26.0x on NTM+1 GAAP EBIT at 0% tax (EV/EBIT, pre-tax). Method 2 (FCF-SBC) is a distinct method family computed deterministically in the check script. Exhibit-4 row label says 'EV derived from GAAP EBITDA' but the applied metric is GAAP EBIT (note quirk, preserved as-is). Scenarios: Downside 355 / Base 725 / Upside 935.

segments.name: Meta Group
segments.rationale: 26.0x EV/GAAP EBIT (unchanged) applied to NTM+1 GAAP EBIT estimates of $101,307mm; revenue_fwd interpolates GS FY27E/FY28E for the NTM+1 window. Pre-tax EBIT basis -> 0% tax in engine terms.
